Why AI visibility matters now: a growing share of people looking for a dance studio ask ChatGPT, Gemini, or Google's AI overview before they ever open a map. Studios that don't structure their site for those tools simply don't get mentioned — regardless of how good the studio actually is. In our checks, every studio the AI engines named was inside Jacksonville itself — none of the four studios in Fernandina Beach, Orange Park, St. Augustine or St. Johns came up.

In Jacksonville, 19 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 19 dance and ballroom studios serving the Jacksonville market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 43 to 82. The AI engines name only six of the 19, and all four studios in Fernandina Beach, Orange Park, St. Augustine and St. Johns were never named once. The field averages 62 (D) on AI readiness, 19 of 19 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 12 of 19 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Jacksonville, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 19 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Studio Jacksonville (82) and Studio 904 (81) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 43. Four scores are shared. Every one of the top five still carries at least one D or F category.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 62 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 19 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 12 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • One of the 19 is a franchise location (one Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #19 is 39 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Jacksonville.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve Jacksonville from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (19 studios): arthurmurrayjacksonville.com, 904dance.com, jacksonville-dance.com, seasideballroom.com, sstyledanceteam.com, absolutedancestudio.com, aabdance.com, kalubys.com, malembedanceco.com, bdaballroom.com, theweddingdancestudio.com, latindancejax.com, giaviselidancesport.com, silverdancestudio.com, thedanceshack.com, dancecenterjax.com, monarchballroomdance.com, sapphireballroomjax.com, salsabachatajacksonville.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Jacksonville dance searches. Left out: A Social Affair Dance Studio and Avondale Dance Directions (no website of their own, though ChatGPT and Gemini name A Social Affair), Duval Dance Studio (social media only), Bold City Salsa and Allure Dance Xperience (no studio address on Google), and the youth, ballet and recital studios that lead the broad answers (Dansations, NOVA Dance and Wellness Academy, Florida Ballet, Barbara Thompson School of Dance).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Jacksonville, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Jacksonville, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons jacksonville fl”; “dance lessons jacksonville fl”; “salsa lessons jacksonville fl”; “wedding dance lessons jacksonville fl”; “ballroom dance lessons orange park fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in jacksonville fl” and “ballroom dance studio jacksonville”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
